As Thou hast yoked me, so am I yoked."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮੈਨੂੰ ਜਿਸ ਪਾਸੇ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੈ, ਮੈਂ ਓਧਰ ਲੱਗੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਾਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41010,"page_no":959,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਾਗਣਿ ਜੈ ਪਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"saiee suohaagan saiee bhaagan jai pir kirapaa dhaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She alone is the blessed soul-bride, and she alone is fortunate, upon whom the Husband Lord has showered His Mercy.","ms":"She alone is the loved bride and she alone is fortunate, to whom her groom extends His grace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹੀ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੋਹਾਗ-ਭਾਗ ਵਾਲੀ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਉਤੇ ਪਤੀ ਨੇ ਆਪ ਮੇਹਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":41011,"page_no":959,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"pir aaugan tis ke sabh gavaae gal setee lai savaaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Her Husband Lord takes away all her faults and mistakes; hugging her close in His embrace, He embellishes her.","ms":"Her Spouse rids her of all her demerits. ਮਨ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਸੁਆਸ ਸੁਆਸ ਖਾਂਦਿਆਂ ਪੀਂਦਿਆਂ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਸਿਮਰ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41087,"page_no":961,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mrit naam nidhaan sach gurmukh paiaa jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.","ms":"The true treasure of the Name-Nectar, is obtained by the Guru's grace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41088,"page_no":961,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥","translit_en":"vaddabhaagee te sa(n)t jan jin man vuThaa aai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come to abide.","ms":"Very fortunate are the saintly persons, within whose mind the Lord has come to abide."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਬੜੇ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41089,"page_no":961,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa dhoojaa koiee naeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.","ms":"God is pervading the ocean, land, nether world and sky and there is not another."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਲ ਵਿਚ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚ ਆਕਾਸ਼ ਵਿਚ (ਹਰ ਥਾਂ) ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ (ਕਿਤੇ ਭੀ) ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41090,"page_no":961,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naam dhiaaiee naam ucharaa naanak khasam rajai ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lord and Master. ||2||","ms":"In the Lord's will, Nanak contemplates the Name and the Name he utters."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! (ਅਰਦਾਸ ਕਰ ਕਿ) ਮੈਂ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਾਂ, ਨਾਮ (ਮੂੰਹ ਨਾਲ) ਉਚਾਰਾਂ ਤੇ ਉਸ ਖਸਮ-ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਰਜ਼ਾ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਾਂ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3539,"next":3541}}
files.shabads/7/3541.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3541,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":22,"page_no":961,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":41091,"last_verse_id":41099,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Raamkalee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41091,"page_no":961,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":41092,"page_no":961,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"jis no too rakhavaalaa maare tis kaun ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?","ms":"He whose Saviour Thou art, O Lord, Him, who can slay?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੈਂ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ (ਵਿਕਾਰ ਆਦਿਕ) ਮਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ,"}}},{"verse_id":41093,"page_no":961,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਭੈਣੁ ॥","translit_en":"jis no too rakhavaalaa jitaa tinai bhain ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.","ms":"He, whose Saviour Thou art, O Lord; he conquers the three worlds."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਤਾਂ (ਸਾਰਾ) ਜਗਤ (ਹੀ) ਜਿੱਤ ਲਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41094,"page_no":961,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"jis no teraa a(n)g tis mukh ujalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.","ms":"He, on whose side Thou art, O Lord; sparkling becomes his face."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੈ ਉਹ (ਮਨੁੱਖਤਾ ਦੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਮੇਵਾਰੀ ਵਿਚ) ਸੁਰਖ਼ਰੂ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":41095,"page_no":961,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥","translit_en":"jis no teraa a(n)gu su niramalee hoo(n) niramalaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.","ms":"He, on whose side Thou art, is the purest of the pure."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਬੜੇ ਹੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਬਣ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41096,"page_no":961,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jis no teree nadhar na lekhaa puchheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.","ms":"He, on whom is Thine grace, O Lord, is not called to account."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੀ (ਮੇਹਰ ਦੀ) ਨਜ਼ਰ ਨਸੀਬ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ (ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਵਿਚ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਦਾ) ਹਿਸਾਬ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ,"}}},{"verse_id":41097,"page_no":961,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jis no teree khusee tin nau nidh bhu(n)cheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.","ms":"He, on whom is Thy pleasure, O Lord, partakes of Thine nine treasures."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੀ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਨੌ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ ਮਾਣ ਲਏ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41098,"page_no":961,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਗੀ ॥","translit_en":"jis no too prabh val tis kiaa muhachha(n)dhagee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?","ms":"He, on whose side Thou art, O Lord, what subservience can lie have?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਜਿਸ ਬੰਦੇ ਦੇ ਧੜੇ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੀ ਮੁਥਾਜੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ"}}},{"verse_id":41099,"page_no":961,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"jis no teree mihar su teree ba(n)dhigee ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8||","ms":"He, on whom is Thy mercy, embraces Thine meditation, O Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਜਿਸ ਉਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੇਹਰ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3540,"next":3542}}
files.shabads/7/3542.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3542,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":22,"page_no":961,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":41100,"last_verse_id":41102,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Raamkalee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41100,"page_no":961,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":41101,"page_no":961,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੇ ॥","translit_en":"hoh kirapaal suaamee mere sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g vihaave ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of the Saints.","ms":"Be Thou merciful, O my Lord, that I may pass my life in the society of saints."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ! ਮੇਰੇ ਉਤੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰ, ਮੇਰੀ ਉਮਰ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਬੀਤੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41102,"page_no":961,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਸਿ ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਨਿ ਹਾਵੇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"tudhahu bhule s jam jam maradhe tin kadhe na chukan haave ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1||","ms":"They, who forget Thee, are born to die again and again and their sorrows end not ever."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤੈਥੋਂ ਵਿੱਛੜ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਜੰਮਦੇ ਮਰਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਾਹੁਕੇ ਕਦੇ ਮੁੱਕਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3541,"next":3543}}
files.shabads/7/3543.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3543,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":22,"page_no":961,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":41103,"last_verse_id":41105,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Raamkalee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41103,"page_no":961,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":41104,"page_no":961,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥","translit_en":"satigur simarahu aapanaa ghaT avaghaT ghaT ghaaT ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on the most difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.","ms":"In thy heart, remember thou thy True Guru, whether thou art on the difficult path, or hillock or wharf."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ (ਆਪਣੇ) ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਉੱਠਦਿਆਂ ਬੈਠਦਿਆਂ ਹਰ ਸਮੇ (ਹਰ ਥਾਂ) ਚੇਤੇ ਰੱਖੋ । "}}},{"verse_id":41105,"page_no":961,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਵਾਟ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"har har naam japa(n)tiaa koi na ba(n)dhai vaaT ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2||","ms":"Because uttering the Lord God's Name, no one shall obstruct thy path."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿਆਂ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦੇ ਰਸਤੇ ਵਿਚ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਰੋਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3542,"next":3544}}
files.shabads/7/3544.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3544,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":22,"page_no":961,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":41106,"last_verse_id":41114,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Raamkalee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41106,"page_no":961,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":41107,"page_no":962,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"tithai too samarath jithai koi naeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where You are, Almighty Lord, there is no one else.","ms":"There Thou art, O Omnipotent Lord, where there is none else."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਜਿੱਥੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ (ਜੀਵ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਕਰਨ ਜੋਗਾ) ਨਹੀਂ ਉਥੇ, ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਜੋਗਾ ਹੈਂ,"}}},{"verse_id":41108,"page_no":962,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਓਥੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖ ਅਗਨੀ ਉਦਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"othai teree rakh aganee udhar maeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There, in the fire of the mother's womb, You protected us.","ms":"There in the fire of mother's womb, Thou protectest the mortal, O Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੇਟ ਦੀ ਅੱਗ ਵਿਚ ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੀ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41109,"page_no":962,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"sun kai jam ke dhoot nai terai chhadd jaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hearing Your Name, the Messenger of Death runs away.","ms":"Hearing Thy Name, the Death's couriers leave off the Mortal."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ) ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਜਮਦੂਤ (ਨੇੜੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਢੁਕਦੇ), ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨਾਲ (ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ) ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਚਲੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41110,"page_no":962,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur sabadhee paar paeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The terrifying, treacherous, impassible world-ocean is crossed over, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.","ms":"The dreadful, formidable and unfathomable world-ocean is crossed through the Guru's instruction."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ ਔਖੇ ਤੇ ਅਥਾਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਨੂੰ ਜੀਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ (ਦੀ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ) ਨਾਲ ਪਾਰ ਕਰ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41111,"page_no":962,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੇਇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"jin kau lagee piaas a(n)mrit sei khaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who feel thirst for You, take in Your Ambrosial Nectar.","ms":"They, who feel thirst for Thee partake of Thy Nectar."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਉਹੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਾਮ-ਜਲ ਛਕਦੇ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਭੱੁਖ-ਪਿਆਸ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":41112,"page_no":962,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੋ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"kal meh eho pu(n)n gun govi(n)dh gaeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This is the only act of goodness in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.","ms":"This is the only virtuous deed in the Darkage, that one sings the praise of the World-Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇਹੜੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚ ਨਾਮ-ਸਿਮਰਨ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਚੰਗਾ ਨੇਕ ਕੰਮ ਜਾਣ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41113,"page_no":962,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"sabhasai no kirapaal sam(h)aale saeh saeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is Merciful to all; He sustains us with each and every breath.","ms":"The Master is merciful to all. He takes care of everyone at every breath."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦੀ ਸੁਆਸ ਸੁਆਸ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41114,"page_no":962,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਹਿ ॥੯॥","translit_en":"birathaa koi na jai j aavai tudh aaeh ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who come to You with love and faith are never turned away empty-handed. ||9||","ms":"O Nanak, none who longingly comes to Thine door, O Lord, returns empty-handed."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਜਿਹੜਾ ਜੀਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ (ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰ ਤੋਂ) ਖ਼ਾਲੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਂਦਾ ।੯।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3543,"next":3545}}
files.shabads/7/3545.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3545,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":22,"page_no":962,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":41115,"last_verse_id":41123,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Raamkalee","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41115,"page_no":962,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":41116,"page_no":962,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਦੂਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"dhoojaa tis na bujhaih paarabraham naam dheh aadhaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those whom You bless with the Support of Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, do not know any other.","ms":"O Transcendent Lord! he, whom Thou givest Thy Name's support; knowest not another."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ! ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਆਸਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁਝਾਉਂਦਾ; "}}},{"verse_id":41117,"page_no":962,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"agam agochar saahibo samarath sach dhaataar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord and Master, All-powerful True Great Giver:","ms":"Inaccessible, Inapprehensible, Omnipotent, True and Munificent is my Master."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੂੰ ਅਪਹੁੰਚ ਹੈਂ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਦੌੜ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ, ਤੂੰ ਹਰੇਕ ਸੱਤਿਆ ਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਲਕ ਹੈਂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ-ਥਿਰ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੈਂ,"}}},{"verse_id":41118,"page_no":962,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਤੂ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"too nihachal niravair sach sachaa tudh dharabaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You are eternal and unchanging, without vengeance and True; True is the Darbaar of Your Court.","ms":"Thou, O Lord, art Moveless Uninimical and True and true is Thy court."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੂੰ ਅਟੱਲ ਹੈਂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਵੈਰ ਨਹੀਂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":41119,"page_no":962,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"keemat kahan na jaieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your worth cannot be described; You have no end or limitation.","ms":"Thine worth can be told not. Thou hast no limit, this and that end."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ, ਤੇਰਾ ਹੱਦ-ਬੰਨਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਭ ਸਕਦਾ, ਤੇਰਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41120,"page_no":962,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"prabh chhodd hor j ma(n)ganaa sabh bikhiaa ras chhaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To forsake God, and ask for something else, is all corruption and ashes.","ms":"To ask for aught else, but the Lord, is vain, All other relishes are poison and dust."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਮੰਗਣੀਆਂ—ਇਹ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਚਸਕੇ ਹਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਹ-ਤੁੱਲ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41121,"page_no":962,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"se sukhe'ee sach saeh se jin sachaa biauhaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They alone find peace, and they are the true kings, whose dealings are true.","ms":"They alone are in peace and they the True kings, whose dealings are true."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਅਸਲ ਵਿਚ) ਉਹੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਹਨ, ਉਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਦਾ-ਥਿਰ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਵਪਾਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41122,"page_no":962,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਾ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"jinaa lagee preet prabh naam sahaj sukh saar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are in love with God's Name, intuitively enjoy the essence of peace.","ms":"They, who cultivate affection for the Lord's Name, are blessed with the quintessence of poise and peace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਬਣੀ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਤਮਕ ਅਡੋਲਤਾ ਦਾ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਸੁਖ ਨਸੀਬ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41123,"page_no":962,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਣਾਰੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak ik aaraadhe sa(n)tan renaar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nanak worships and adores the One Lord; he seeks the dust of the Saints. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, meditates on the One Lord and seeks the dust of the feet of the saints."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਧੂੜ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਅਰਾਧਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3544,"next":3546}}

files.shabads/7/3612.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3612,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":23,"page_no":975,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":11,"first_verse_id":41694,"last_verse_id":41704,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Nat Naaraayan","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41694,"page_no":975,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nat, Fourth Mehla:","ms":"Nat 4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":41695,"page_no":975,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥","translit_en":"mere man jap har har naam sakhe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend.","ms":"O my soul, utter thou the Name of the Lord God, thy Friend."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ! ਸਦਾ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿਆ ਕਰ । (ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮਿ ਹੀ ਅਸਲ) ਮਿੱਤਰ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41696,"page_no":976,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"gur parasaadhee har naam dhiaaio ham satigur charan pakhe ||1|| rahaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||","ms":"By Guru's grace, I ponder over God's Name and shampoo the True Guru's Feet. Pause."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਭੀ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ (ਜਪਿਆ ਹੈ) ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਜਪਿਆ ਹੈ । (ਇਸ ਵਾਸਤੇ) ਮੈਂ ਭੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨ ਹੀ ਧੋਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ (ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਰਨ ਹੀ ਪਿਆ ਹਾਂ) ।੧।ਰਹਾਉ।"}}},{"verse_id":41697,"page_no":976,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਊਤਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਖੇ ॥","translit_en":"uootam jaga(n)naath jagadheesur ham paapee saran rakhe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary","ms":"The sublime Lord of the world and the Master of Universe, keeps me, the sinner, in His refuge."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ! ਹੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਨਾਥ! ਹੇ ਜਗਤ ਈਸ਼੍ਵਰ! ਮੈਂ ਪਾਪੀ ਹਾਂ, ਪਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨ ਆ ਪਿਆ ਹਾਂ, ਮੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰ । ਤੂੰ ਵੱਡਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੈਂ, ਤੂੰ ਦੀਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41698,"page_no":976,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"tum vadd purakh dheen dhukh bha(n)jan har dheeo naam mukhe ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||","ms":"Thou, O Great Lord-God, the Destroyer of the Sorrow of the meek, hast blessed me with Thy sublime Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੂੰ ਵੱਡਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੈਂ, ਤੂੰ ਦੀਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ । ਹੇ ਹਰੀ! (ਜਿਸ ਉਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਸ ਦੇ) ਮੂੰਹ ਵਿਚ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ ।੧।"}}},{"verse_id":41699,"page_no":976,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੇ ॥","translit_en":"har gun uooch neech ham gaae gur satigur sa(n)g sakhe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, my Friend.","ms":"Meeting with the Great True Guru, my friend, I, the mental, have hymned the lofty qualities of God."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਤੂੰ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ਼ ਵਰਗੇ ਦੁਸ਼ਟਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਤਾਰ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ ।੪।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3611,"next":3613}}

files.shabads/7/3624.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3624,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":23,"page_no":979,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":41807,"last_verse_id":41813,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Nat Naaraayan","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":41807,"page_no":979,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"naT mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nat, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Nat 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":41808,"page_no":979,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal sa(n)g laagee ddoree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The string of my love is tied to Your Lotus Feet.","ms":"To Thine lotus-feet, bear I love, O Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਦੀ ਤਾਰ ਲੱਗ ਗਈ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41809,"page_no":979,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"sukh saagar kar param gat moree ||1|| rahaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, ocean of peace, please bless me with the supreme status. ||1||Pause||","ms":"O my Lord, the ocean of peace, emancipate Thou me. ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਨਾਮ-ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰ ਲਿਆ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ (ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਵਿਚ) ਬਹੁਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ; "}}},{"verse_id":41983,"page_no":984,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥","translit_en":"tin kee pa(n)k paieeaai vaddabhaagee jan naanak charan paraataa ||4||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak falls at their feet. ||4||2||","ms":"By great good luck, one is blessed with the dust of their feet. Slave Nanak falls at their feet."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਧੂੜ ਵੱਡੇ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ । ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ (ਭੀ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ) ਚਰਨੀਂ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੪।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3636,"next":3638}}

ਅਸੀ ਜੀਵ ਨੀਵੇਂ ਤੇ ਹੌਲੇ ਮੇਲ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਹੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਕਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਪਾਤਿਸ਼ਾਹ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41988,"page_no":985,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"har aan melio satiguroo khin ba(n)dh mukat karaio ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me from bondage. ||1||","ms":"God has led me to meet my True Guru, who, in an instant, has freed me of my bonds."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਆ ਕੇ ਮਿਲਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਵਿਚ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਖ਼ਲਾਸੀ ਦਿਵਾ ਦਿੱਤੀ ।੨।"}}},{"verse_id":41989,"page_no":985,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਸਤਕੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"prabh masatake dhur leekhiaa gurmatee har liv laio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine love for the Lord.","ms":"Such is the Lord's pre-ordained writ on my brow, that by Guru's instruction, I have now come to embrace affection for my God."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! Meeting my Lord, I now sing the songs of rejoicing."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿਚ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ (ਮਾਨੋ) ਪੰਜਾਂ ਕਿਸਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦਾ ਰਾਗ ਹੋ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ (ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਮਿਲ ਪਿਆ, ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਦਾ ਗੀਤ ਹੀ ਗਾਂਦਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}},{"verse_id":41991,"page_no":985,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"patit paavan naam narahar ma(n)dhabhaageeaa(n) nahee bhaio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretches do not like this.","ms":"The Purifier of sinners is the Name of the exalted Lord, The unfortunate ones like it not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਕਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਬਦ-ਕਿਸਮਤ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":41992,"page_no":985,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਤੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਗਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"te garabh jonee gaale'eeh jiau lon jaleh galaio ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||","ms":"They putrefy in the womb existences and dissolve like salt in water."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਂ ਲੂਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚ ਪਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਗਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਿਵੇਂ ਉਹ (ਮੰਦ-ਭਾਗੀ) ਬੰਦੇ (ਨਾਮ-ਹੀਣ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ) ਅਨੇਕਾਂ ਜੂਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਗਾਲੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੩।"}}},{"verse_id":41993,"page_no":985,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"mat dheh har prabh agam Thaakur gur charan man mai laio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord and Master, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.","ms":"Bless Thou me with such understanding O my Infinite God, the Lord-Master, that my soul may remain attached to the Guru's feet."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/7/3664.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3664,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":991,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":42272,"last_verse_id":42280,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":42272,"page_no":991,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Maaroo, First Mehla:","ms":"Maru 1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":42273,"page_no":991,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੋਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੋਮ ਸਰੁ ਪੋਖਿ ਲੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਤੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥","translit_en":"soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat kar maratu su sanaba(n)dh keejai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the left nostril; practicing this breath-control, bring them into perfect balance.","ms":"Burn thou off thy fiery nature and foster thy cool and calm disposition, Put thou thy life-breath in the right channel an d establish good relation with Thy Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਜੋਗੀ!) ਤੂੰ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ (ਇਹ ਹੈ ਸੱਜੀ ਨਾਸ ਦੇ ਰਸਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਉਤਾਰਨੇ), ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਨੂੰ (ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ) ਤਕੜਾ ਕਰ (ਇਹ ਹੈ ਖੱਬੀ ਨਾਸ ਦੇ ਰਸਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਣੇ) । ਸੁਆਸ ਸੁਆਸ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਦਾ ਸੁਚੱਜਾ ਢੰਗ ਬਣਾ (ਇਹ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਨਾੜੀ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕਾਣਾ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":42274,"page_no":991,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||","ms":"In this way, thy fish like mercurial mind shall be held and thy soul-swan shall fly not away from thy Lord and thy body-wall shall perish not, in vain."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਬੱਸ! files.shabads/7/3693.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3693,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1002,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":11,"first_verse_id":42657,"last_verse_id":42667,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":42657,"page_no":1002,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"maaroo mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Maru5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":42658,"page_no":1002,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਾਹਿ ॥","translit_en":"jiseh saaj nivaajiaa tiseh siau ruch naeh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.","ms":"He who created and honoured thee; Him thou bear not love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! ਜਿਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਕਈ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਸ਼ਾਂ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਹਨ, ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":42659,"page_no":1002,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ ਬੋਈਐ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"aan rootee aan boieeaai fal na foolai taeh ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit. ||1||","ms":"The ungenial seed, sown out of season; bear not fruit and flower."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ਆਹਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਲੱਗਾ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਪਰ ਜੇ) ਰੁੱਤ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਵੇ, ਬੀਜ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਬੀਜ ਦੇਈਏ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਹ ਫੁੱਲ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਹ ਫਲ ।੧।"}}},{"verse_id":42660,"page_no":1002,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਜਣ ਨਾਉ ॥","translit_en":"re man vatr beejan naau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.","ms":"O man, this is the suitable time to sow the Name-Seed."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ (ਮੇਰੇ) ਮਨ! as Gurmukh, practice Truth.","ms":"Practising truth, through the Guru's grace, enjoy thou the griefless Kingdom."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਹੇ ਭਾਈ!) ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਕਰ (ਤੇ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ) ਨਿਰਚੋਭ ਰਾਜ ਮਾਣ,"}}},{"verse_id":46453,"page_no":1087,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"sachai takhat baiThaa niaau kar satasa(n)gat mel milaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sitting upon the throne of Truth, the Lord administers justice; He unites us in Union with the Society of the Saints.","ms":"Sitting on the True Throne, the Lord administers justice and unites one in the union of the saints congregation."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਦਾ-ਥਿਰ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਤੇ ਬਹਿ ਕੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ ਮਿਲਾ ਦੇਵੇਗਾ,"}}},{"verse_id":46454,"page_no":1087,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥","translit_en":"sachaa upadhes har jaapanaa har siau ban aaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meditating on the Lord, through the True Teachings, we become just like the Lord.","ms":"Contemplating the Lord-God by the True Guru's instruction, the mortal succeeds with Him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਓਥੇ ਨਾਮ-ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦੀ ਸੱਚੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇਆਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਲ ਬਣ ਆਵੇਗੀ, "}}},{"verse_id":46455,"page_no":1087,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"aaithai sukhadhaataa man vasai a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If the Lord, the Giver of peace, abides in the mind, in this world, then in the end, He becomes our help and support.","ms":"If the Peace-giving Lord abides in man's mind here, then becomes He his succourer in the end."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਿਚ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰੱਬ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸੇਗਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਤ ਵੇਲੇ ਭੀ ਸਾਥੀ ਬਣੇਗਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46456,"page_no":1087,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"har siau preet uoopajee gur sojhee paiee ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Love for the Lord wells up, when the Guru imparts understanding. ||2||","ms":"When the Guru imparts understanding, then wells up in the man's mind, the love for the Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਸਮਝ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3803,"next":3805}}
files.shabads/7/3805.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3805,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1087,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":46457,"last_verse_id":46461,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46457,"page_no":1087,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, First Mehla:","ms":"Slok 1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46458,"page_no":1087,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"bhoolee bhoolee mai firee paadhar kahai na koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Confused and deluded, I wander around, but no one shows me the way.","ms":"Mistaken and gone-amiss, I wander about and no one tells me the way."},"pu":{"ss":"ਬਥੇਰੇ ਚਿਰ ਤੋਂ ਖੁੰਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਮੈਂ ਭਟਕ ਰਹੀ ਹਾਂ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਪੱਧਰਾ ਰਾਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਦਾ,"}}},{"verse_id":46459,"page_no":1087,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"poochhahu jai siaaniaa dhukh kaaTai meraa koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I go and ask the clever people, if there is there anyone who can rid me of my pain.","ms":"I go and ask the wise, If there any one who can rid me of my suffering?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਕੋਈ ਧਿਰ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛੋ, ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਸ਼ਟ ਕੱਟ ਦੇਵੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46460,"page_no":1087,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਠਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"satigur saachaa man vasai saajan ut hee Thai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If the True Guru abides within my mind, then I see the Lord, my best friend, there.","ms":"If the True Satguru, abides within my mind, I see my Lord, the Friend, in that very place."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੇ ਸੱਚਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਆ ਵੱਸੇ ਤਾਂ ਸੱਜਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੀ ਓਸੇ ਥਾਂ (ਭਾਵ, ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਮਿਲ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ),"}}},{"verse_id":46461,"page_no":1087,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀਐ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak man tirapataaseeaai sifatee saachai nai ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, my mind is satisfied and fulfilled, contemplating the Praises of the True Name. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, hymning the praise of the True Name, the soul is satiated."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ-ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿਆਂ ਮਨ ਭਟਕਣੋਂ ਹਟ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3804,"next":3806}}
files.shabads/7/3806.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3806,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1087,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":46462,"last_verse_id":46465,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46462,"page_no":1087,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46463,"page_no":1087,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"aape karanee kaar aap aape kare rajai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself is the Doer, and He is the deed; He Himself issues the Command.","ms":"God Himself is the conduct, Himself the deed and Himself issues commands."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਣੀ ਰਜ਼ਾ ਵਿਚ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਨ-ਜੋਗ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":46464,"page_no":1087,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"aape kis hee bakhas le aape kaar kamai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself forgives some, and He Himself does the deed.","ms":"He, of Himself, forgives some and of Himself performs service."},"pu":{"ss":"ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ ਆਪ ਹੀ (ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਉਸ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੱਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੀ) ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46465,"page_no":1087,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak chaanan gur mile dhukh bikh jaalee nai ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, receiving the Divine Light from the Guru, suffering and corruption are burnt away, through the Name. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, obtaining the Divine Light from the Guru, man burns off his suffering and sin through the Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹ ‘ਨਾਮ’ ਸਿਮਰ ਕੇ ਵਿਹੁ-ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੋਂ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੋਏ ਦੁੱਖ ਸਾੜ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3805,"next":3807}}
files.shabads/7/3807.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3807,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1087,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46466,"last_verse_id":46471,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46466,"page_no":1087,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46467,"page_no":1087,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੂ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"maiaa vekh na bhul too manmukh moorakhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Don't be fooled by gazing at the riches of Maya, you foolish self-willed manmukh.","ms":"O foolish perverse person be thou not misled by beholding riches."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮੂਰਖ! ਹੇ ਮਨ ਦੇ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮ! ਮਾਇਆ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਉਕਾਈ ਨਾਹ ਖਾਹ,"}}},{"verse_id":46468,"page_no":1087,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਲਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"chaladhiaa naal na chaliee sabh jhooTh dharab lakhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It shall not go along with you when you must depart; all the wealth you see is false.","ms":"All the wealth which thou see is false and at the time of departure, if shall go not with thee."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ (ਏਥੋਂ) ਤੁਰਨ ਵੇਲੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਤੁਰਦੀ, ਸੋ, ਸਾਰੇ ਧਨ ਨੂੰ ਝੂਠਾ (ਸਾਥੀ) ਜਾਣ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46469,"page_no":1087,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਲਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"agiaanee a(n)dh na boojhiee sir uoopar jam khaRag kalakhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The blind and ignorant do not understand, that the sword of death is hanging over their heads.","ms":"The ignorant blind man knows not, that Death's sword is hanging over his head."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ) ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਮਝਦਾ ਕਿ ਸਿਰ ਉਤੇ ਜਮ ਦੀ ਮੌਤ ਦੀ ਤਲਵਾਰ ਭੀ ਹੈ (ਤੇ ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਸਾਥ ਟੁੱਟਣਾ ਹੈ) ।"}}},{"verse_id":46470,"page_no":1087,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"gur parasaadhee ubare jin har ras chakhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By Guru's Grace, those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are saved.","ms":"They, who in-drink God's elixir, are saved by the Guru's grace,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਨੇ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਰਸ ਚੱਖਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਨਾਲ (ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚ ਮੋਹ ਪਾਣ ਦੀ ਉਕਾਈ ਤੋਂ) ਬਚ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ;"}}},{"verse_id":46471,"page_no":1088,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"aap karaae kare aap aape har rakhaa ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause; the Lord Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||","ms":"God Himself is the Doer and Himself the Cause. The Lord Himself saves."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ (ਉੱਦਮ) ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪ ਹੀ (ਜੀਵ ਪਾਸੋਂ) ਕਰਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ (ਜੀਵ ਵਿਚ ਬੈਠ ਕੇ, ਮਾਨੋ) ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੀਵ ਦਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹੈ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3806,"next":3808}}
files.shabads/7/3808.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3808,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":46472,"last_verse_id":46476,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46472,"page_no":1088,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46473,"page_no":1088,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿੰਦ ॥","translit_en":"jinaa gur nahee bheTiaa bhai kee naahee bi(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who do not meet with the Guru, who have no Fear of God at all,","ms":"They, who meet not with the Guru and have not slightest fear of God,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਿਆ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਰੱਬ ਦਾ ਰਤਾ ਭੀ ਡਰ ਨਹੀਂ,"}}},{"verse_id":46474,"page_no":1088,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥","translit_en":"aavan jaavan dhukh ghanaa kadhe na chookai chi(n)dh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"continue coming and going in reincarnation, and suffer terrible pain; their anxiety is never relieved.","ms":"suffer great pain in coming and going and their anxiety ceases not ever."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਨ (ਦਾ) ਡਾਢਾ ਦੁੱਖ ਲੱਗਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਦੇ ਮੁੱਕਦੀ ਨਹੀਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46475,"page_no":1088,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਪੜ ਜਿਵੈ ਪਛੋੜੀਐ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥","translit_en":"kaapaR jivai pachhoReeaai ghaRee muhat ghaReeaal ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are beaten like clothes being washed on the rocks, and struck every hour like chimes.","ms":"They are struck like the soiled clothes and beaten every hour or two hours like a gong."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਂ (ਧੋਣ ਵੇਲੇ) ਕੱਪੜਾ (ਪਟੜੇ ਤੇ) ਪਟਕਾਈਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਘੜਿਆਲ ਮੁੜ ਮੁੜ (ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ)"}}},{"verse_id":46476,"page_no":1088,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak sache naam bin sirahu na chukai ja(n)jaal ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, without the True Name, these entanglements are not removed from hanging over one's head. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, without the True Name, the entanglement from over their head is removed not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਤਿਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਨਾਮ ਤੋਂ ਵਾਂਜੇ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਿਰ ਤੋਂ (ਭੀ) ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੁੱਕਦਾ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3807,"next":3809}}
files.shabads/7/3809.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3809,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":46477,"last_verse_id":46479,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46477,"page_no":1088,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46478,"page_no":1088,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਢੂਢੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੁਰੀ ਜਗਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"tirabhavan ddooddee sajanaa haumai buree jagat ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have searched throughout the three worlds, O my friend; egotism is bad for the world.","ms":"I have searched the three, worlds, my friend, and discovered that pride is bad for the world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਸੱਜਣ (ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਮੈਂ ਤਿੰਨਾਂ ਹੀ ਭਵਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਭਾਲ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ ‘ਹਉਮੈ’ ਚੰਦਰੀ (ਬਲਾ ਚੰਬੜੀ ਹੋਈ) ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46479,"page_no":1088,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾ ਝੁਰੁ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naa jhur heeaRe sach chau naanak sacho sach ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Don't worry, O my soul; speak the Truth, O Nanak, the Truth, and only the Truth. ||2||","ms":"Grieve not, O my soul, speak thou the truth; Nanak nothing but the truth."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਪਰ) ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਦਿਲ! (ਇਸ ‘ਹਉਮੈ’ ਤੋਂ ਘਾਬਰ ਕੇ) ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾਹ ਕਰ, ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰ ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਹੀ ਥਿਰ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3808,"next":3810}}
files.shabads/7/3810.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3810,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46480,"last_verse_id":46485,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46480,"page_no":1088,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46481,"page_no":1088,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh aape bakhasion har naam samaane ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord Himself forgives the Gurmukhs; they are absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name.","ms":"The Guru-wards the Lord Himself forgives and they merge in the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਰਨ ਪੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਅਸਰ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ; ਵੇਖੋ ਪਉੜੀ ੩), ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜਦੇ ਹਨ । "}}},{"verse_id":46482,"page_no":1088,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੇ ॥","translit_en":"aape bhagatee laion gur sabadh neesaane ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He Himself links them to devotional worship; they bear the Insignia of the Guru's Shabad.","ms":"He Himself yokes them to His service and they are stamped with the Guru's word."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਅਸਰ ਤੋਂ ਨਿਖੇੜਨ ਵਾਲਾ) ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਲਾ ਕੇ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਸ ਨੇ (ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੂੰ) ਭਗਤੀ ਵਿਚ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46483,"page_no":1088,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥","translit_en":"sanamukh sadhaa sohane sachai dhar jaane ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who turn towards the Guru, as sunmukh, are beautiful. They are famous in the Court of the True Lord.","ms":"Ever beauteous are those faithful ones and they are renowned in the True Court."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਦਰ ਤੇ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨੀਵੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਨੀਆਂ ਪੈਂਦੀਆਂ, (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਕੇ) ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੂੰਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਦਰ ਤੇ ਆਦਰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46484,"page_no":1088,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥","translit_en":"aaithai othai mukat hai jin raam pachhaane ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this world, and in the world hereafter, they are liberated; they realize the Lord.","ms":"Here and there emancipated are they, who realise their Pervading God."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸਾਂਝ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਵਿਚ (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਤੋਂ) ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46485,"page_no":1088,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥","translit_en":"dha(n)n dha(n)n se jan jin har seviaa tin hau kurabaane ||4||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who serve the Lord. I am a sacrifice to them. ||4||","ms":"Blessed! blessed are the persons, who serve their Lord. Unto them I am a sacrifice."},"pu":{"ss":"ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਬੰਦੇ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ, ਮੈਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਕੇ ਹਾਂ ।੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3809,"next":3811}}
files.shabads/7/3811.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3811,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":46486,"last_verse_id":46488,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46486,"page_no":1088,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, First Mehla:","ms":"Slok 1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46487,"page_no":1088,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹਲ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਮੜਵੜੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਮਨਹੁ ਕਸੁਧ ॥","translit_en":"mahal kuchajee maRavaRee kaalee manahu kasudh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The rude, ill-mannered bride is encased in the body-tomb; she is blackened, and her mind is impure.","ms":"The ill-mannered soul-bride is engrossed in the body tomb, She is black and of unclean mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ (ਜੀਵ-) ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਚੱਜ ਨਹੀਂ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੈ, ਮੈਲੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46488,"page_no":1088,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੁੰਧ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"je gun hovan taa pir ravai naanak avagun mu(n)dh ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She can enjoy her Husband Lord, only if she is virtuous. O Nanak, the soul-bride is unworthy, and without virtue. ||1||","ms":"If she has merits, then alone can she enjoy her spouse, but, O Nanak, the bride abounds in demerits."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/7/3812.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3812,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":46489,"last_verse_id":46491,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46489,"page_no":1088,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"First Mehla:","ms":"1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46490,"page_no":1088,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"saach seel sach sa(n)jamee saa pooree paravaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She has good conduct, true self-discipline, and a perfect family.","ms":"She alone is of good conduct, truly self-disciplined, accomplished in the family,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹੀ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਚਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਤੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਾਲੀ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਿਚ ਮੰਨੀ-ਪ੍ਰਮੰਨੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46491,"page_no":1088,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak ahinis sadhaa bhalee pir kai het piaar ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, day and night, she is always good; she loves her Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||","ms":"and ever good, who, O Nanak, day and night remains imbued with the love and affection of her Spouse."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਤੀ ਦੇ ਹਿਤ ਵਿਚ ਪਿਆਰ ਵਿਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਦਿਨੇ ਰਾਤ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਚੰਗੀ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3811,"next":3813}}
files.shabads/7/3813.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3813,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46492,"last_verse_id":46497,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46492,"page_no":1088,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46493,"page_no":1088,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa naam nidhaan paiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who realizes his own self, is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.","ms":"He, who knows himself, is blessed with the treasure of the Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਨੂੰ (ਸਦਾ) ਪੜਤਾਲਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਮ-ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":46494,"page_no":1088,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"kirapaa kar kai aapanee gur sabadh milaiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Granting His Mercy, the Guru merges him in the Word of His Shabad.","ms":"Showering his benediction, the Guru merges him in the Guru's word."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਣੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਿਚ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":46495,"page_no":1088,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"gur kee baanee niramalee har ras peeaaiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Word of the Guru's Bani is immaculate and pure; through it, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.","ms":"Immaculate is the Guru's word, Through it, the mortal in drinks the Lord's elixir."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੇ, ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਰਸ ਪਿਲਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46496,"page_no":1088,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥","translit_en":"har ras jinee chaakhiaa an ras Thaak rahaiaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, forsake other flavors.","ms":"They, who taste the Lord's Nectar, forsake and renounce other relishes."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਨਾਮ-ਰਸ ਚੱਖਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਹੋਰ ਰਸਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਰਜ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਨ (ਭਾਵ, ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਚਸਕਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਢੁਕਣ ਦੇਂਦੇ); "}}},{"verse_id":46497,"page_no":1088,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"har ras pee sadhaa tirapat bhe fir tirasanaa bhukh gavaiaa ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, they remain satisfied forever; their hunger and thirst are quenched. ||5||","ms":"Quaffing God's ambrosia, they ever remain satiated and their thirst and hunger are quenched."},"pu":{"ss":"ਨਾਮ-ਰਸ ਪੀ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਰੱਜੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਤੇ ਭੁੱਖ ਨਾਸ ਕਰ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3812,"next":3814}}
files.shabads/7/3814.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3814,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":46498,"last_verse_id":46500,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46498,"page_no":1088,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46499,"page_no":1088,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰ ਖੁਸੀਏ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਏ ਧਨ ਉਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"pir khuse'ee dhan raave'ee dhan ur naam seegaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Her Husband Lord is pleased, and He enjoys His bride; the soul-bride adorns her heart with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.","ms":"In His pleasure, the Spouse enjoys the bride, the bride who bedecks her heart."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ‘ਨਾਮ’-ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਪਤੀ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46500,"page_no":1088,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨ ਆਗੈ ਖੜੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak dhan aagai khaRee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, that bride who stands before Him, is the most noble and respected woman. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, the bride who stands before her Spouse is an illustrious women."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੋ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਪਤੀ ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿਚ ਖਲੋਤੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3813,"next":3815}}
files.shabads/7/3815.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3815,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":46501,"last_verse_id":46503,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46501,"page_no":1088,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"First Mehla:","ms":"1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46502,"page_no":1088,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"sasurai peieeaai ka(n)t kee ka(n)t aga(n)m athaahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In her father-in-law's home hereafter, and in her parents' home in this world, she belongs to her Husband Lord. Her Husband is inaccessible and unfathomable.","ms":"Both here and hereafter, the bride belongs to her Husband, the Husband who is Unapproachable and Unfathomable."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਖਸਮ ਅਪਹੁੰਚ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਹੈ; ਜੋ ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਸਹੁਰੇ-ਘਰ ਤੇ ਪੇਕੇ-ਘਰ (ਦੋਹੀਂ ਥਾਈਂ, ਭਾਵ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਵਿਚ ਉਸ) ਖਸਮ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":46503,"page_no":1088,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak dha(n)n suohaaganee jo bhaaveh veparavaeh ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, she is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to her carefree, independent Lord. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, blessed are the chaste wives, who are pleasing to their Care-free Lord."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੇ (ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ) ਉਸ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰੀਆਂ ਲੱਗਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ  ਉਹ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਹਨ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3814,"next":3816}}
files.shabads/7/3816.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3816,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1088,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46504,"last_verse_id":46509,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46504,"page_no":1088,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46505,"page_no":1088,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੋ ਬਹੈ ਜਿ ਤਖਤੈ ਲਾਇਕ ਹੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"takhat raajaa so bahai j takhatai laik hoiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That king sits upon the throne, who is worthy of that throne.","ms":"That King alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਦੇ ਜੋਗ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਣ ਕੇ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਤੇ ਬੈਠਦਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਜੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ‘ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਭੁਖ’ ਗਵਾ ਕੇ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਆਦਰ ਪਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ);"}}},{"verse_id":46506,"page_no":1088,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥","translit_en":"jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach raaje seiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who realize the True Lord, they alone are the true kings.","ms":"They, who realise the True Lord, They alone are the True Kings."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸੋ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਲ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸਾਂਝ ਪਾ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਅਸਲ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46507,"page_no":1088,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਏਹਿ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"eh bhoopat raaje na aakhe'eeh dhoojai bhai dhukh hoiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These mere earthly rulers are not called kings; in the love of duality, they suffer.","ms":"These Lords of earth are not called kings. Through love of another, they come to grief."},"pu":{"ss":"ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਬਣੇ ਹੋਏ ਇਹ ਲੋਕ ਰਾਜੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਹੇ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ, "}}},{"verse_id":46508,"page_no":1088,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥","translit_en":"keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai jis jaadhe bilam na hoiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Why should someone praise someone else who is also created? They depart in no time at all.","ms":"Why should man praise the created one, who makes no delay in departing?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ (ਇਕ ਤਾਂ) ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਕਰਕੇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁੱਖ ਵਾਪਰਦਾ ਹੈ, (ਦੂਜੇ) ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੀਹ ਵਡਿਆਉਣਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਜੋ ਪੈਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਸ ਹੁੰਦਿਆਂ ਚਿਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46509,"page_no":1088,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"nihachal sachaa ek hai gurmukh boojhai su nihachal hoiee ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The One True Lord is eternal and imperishable. One who, as Gurmukh, understands becomes eternal as well. ||6||","ms":"Eternal is the True Lord alone He who understands Him through the Guru, become eternal as well."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਟੱਲ ਰਾਜ ਵਾਲਾ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੀ ਹੈ । ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਸਮਝ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਭੀ (“ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਭੁਖ” ਵਲੋਂ) ਅਡੋਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੬।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3815,"next":3817}}

files.shabads/7/3826.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3826,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1089,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":46555,"last_verse_id":46559,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46555,"page_no":1089,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46556,"page_no":1089,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਊਜਲਾ ਲੋਹੇ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"kaagau hoi na uoojalaa lohe naav na paar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The crow does not become white, and an iron boat does not float across.","ms":"A crow becomes not white nor does and iron boat float."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਚਿੱਟਾ (ਹੰਸ) ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣ ਸਕਦਾ, ਲੋਹੇ ਦੀ ਬੇੜੀ (ਨਦੀ ਦਾ) ਪਾਰਲਾ ਕੰਢਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਭ ਸਕਦੀ;"}}},{"verse_id":46557,"page_no":1089,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"piram padhaarath ma(n)n lai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who puts his faith in the treasure of his Beloved Lord is blessed; he exalts and embellishes others as well.","ms":"Blessed is he whom puts faith in the wealth of his Beloved. He regenerates others, as well."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸੇ ਉਸ ਸਵਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ (ਗੁਰੂ) ਨੂੰ (ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਕਾਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਮਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਭੀ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ,"}}},{"verse_id":46558,"page_no":1089,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਊਜਲਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"hukam pachhaanai uoojalaa sir kaasaT lohaa paar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command - his face is radiant and bright; he floats across, like iron upon wood.","ms":"The countenance of him, who recognises the Lord's will, becomes bright and he crosses over like iron on timber."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੁਕਮ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ (ਕਾਂ ਤੋਂ) ਹੰਸ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ (ਜਿਵੇਂ) ਲੱਕੜ ਦੇ ਆਸਰੇ ਲੋਹਾ (ਨਦੀ ਦੇ) ਪਾਰਲੇ ਕੰਢੇ ਜਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ;"}}},{"verse_id":46559,"page_no":1089,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਭੈ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"tirasanaa chhoddai bhai vasai naanak karanee saar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Forsake thirst and desire, and abide in the Fear of God; O Nanak, these are the most excellent actions. ||1||","ms":"To abandon greed and to abide in the Lord's fear, O Nanak, are the meritorious deeds."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਆਸਰੇ) ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਰੱਬ ਦੇ ਡਰ ਵਿਚ ਜੀਊਂਦਾ ਹੈ, (ਬੱਸ!) ਇਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਚੰਗੀ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3825,"next":3827}}
files.shabads/7/3827.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3827,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1089,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":46560,"last_verse_id":46564,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46560,"page_no":1089,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46561,"page_no":1089,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਰੂ ਮਾਰਣ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"maaroo maaran jo ge maar na sakeh gavaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ignorant people who go to the desert to conquer their minds, are not able to conquer them.","ms":"The ignorant ones, who go to deserts to overcome their mind, can overcome it not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮੂਰਖ ਬਾਹਰ ਜੰਗਲਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰਨ ਵਾਸਤੇ ਗਏ ਉਹ ਮਾਰ ਨ ਸਕੇ;"}}},{"verse_id":46562,"page_no":1089,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"naanak je ih maareeaai gur sabadhee veechaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, if this mind is to be conquered, one must contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.","ms":"Nanak, if this mind is to be subdued the mortal must reflect on the Guru's instruction."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੇ ਇਹ ਮਨ ਵੱਸ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕੀਤਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਵੱਸ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":46563,"page_no":1089,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"eh man maariaa naa marai je lochai sabh koi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This mind is not conquered by conquering it, even though everyone longs to do so.","ms":"By subduing this mind is subdued not, even though everyone may so desire."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਨਹੀਂ ਤਾਂ ਉਂਞ) ਭਾਵੇਂ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਤਨੀ ਹੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਕਰੇ ਇਹ ਮਨ ਜਤਨ ਕੀਤਿਆਂ ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46564,"page_no":1089,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak man hee kau man maarasee je satigur bheTai soi ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the mind itself conquers the mind, if one meets with the True Guru. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, if the True Guru is met with, the mind itself overpowers the mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੇ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲ ਪਏ ਤਾਂ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਹੈਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਅੰਦਰ ਵਲ ਪਰਤਿਆਂ ਮਨ ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ) ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3826,"next":3828}}
files.shabads/7/3828.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3828,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1090,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46565,"last_verse_id":46570,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46565,"page_no":1090,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46566,"page_no":1090,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਈਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਵਾਸਾ ॥","translit_en":"dhovai tarafaa upaieeon vich sakat siv vaasaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He created both sides; I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||","ms":"Without the name, nothing is stable, O Nanak, So, a sacrifice unto the Lord's Name, am I."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ‘ਨਾਮ’ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸ਼ੈ ਥਿਰ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਨਹੀਂ; files.shabads/7/3829.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3829,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1090,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":46571,"last_verse_id":46575,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46571,"page_no":1090,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46572,"page_no":1090,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥","translit_en":"hovaa pa(n)ddit jotakee vedh paRaa mukh chaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I might become a Pandit, a religious scholar, or an astrologer, and recite the four Vedas with my mouth;","ms":"If I become a Brahman or an astrologer and utter the four Vedas with my mouth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਾਈ! files.shabads/7/3840.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3840,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1091,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":46617,"last_verse_id":46619,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46617,"page_no":1091,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"First Mehla:","ms":"1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46618,"page_no":1091,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਂਦਲੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਸਿ ਬਾਜਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਧੜੀਐ ਜੋਇ ॥","translit_en":"maa(n)dhal bedh s baajano ghano dhaReeaai joi ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The drum of the Vedas vibrates, bringing dispute and divisiveness.","ms":"The drum of the Vedas, which preach many dissension, is ringing."},"pu":{"ss":"ਘਣਾ ਧੜਾ (ਭਾਵ, ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ) ਤੱਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਢੋਲ ਨੂੰ (ਜੋ ਢੋਲ) ਵੇਦ ਨੇ ਵਜਾਇਆ {ਭਾਵ, ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਦਾ ਰਸਤਾ} ।"}}},{"verse_id":46619,"page_no":1091,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak naam samaal too beejau avar na koi ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; there is none except Him. ||2||","ms":"O Nanak, contemplate thou the Lord's Name, for without Him, there is not any other."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਤੂੰ ‘ਨਾਮ’ ਸਿਮਰ, (ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਛੁਟ) ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ (ਸਹੀ ਰਸਤਾ) ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3839,"next":3841}}
files.shabads/7/3841.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3841,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1091,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":46620,"last_verse_id":46624,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46620,"page_no":1091,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"First Mehla:","ms":"1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46621,"page_no":1091,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਹਾਥਾਲਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"saagar gunee athaahu kin haathaalaa dhekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The world-ocean of the three qualities is unfathomably deep; how can its bottom be seen?","ms":"Unfathomable is the world-ocean of three qualities; who has ever seen its bottom?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਇਹ) ਤੈ੍ਰ-ਗੁਣੀ (ਸੰਸਾਰ) (ਮਾਨੋ) ਇਕ ਅੱਤ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਦੀ ਹਾਥ ਕਿਸ ਨੇ ਲੱਭੀ ਹੈ?"}}},{"verse_id":46622,"page_no":1091,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾ ॥","translit_en":"vaddaa veparavaahu satigur milai ta paar pavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If I meet with the great, self-sufficient True Guru, then I am carried across.","ms":"If I meet with the exceedingly carefree True Guru, then alone can I ferry across."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ (ਜੋ ਇਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਲੋਂ) ਬੜਾ ਬੇ-ਪਰਵਾਹ (ਹੈ) ਮਿਲ ਪਏ ਤਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਭੀ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘ ਜਾਵਾਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46623,"page_no":1091,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਮਝ ਭਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਬਦੁਖ ॥","translit_en":"majh bhar dhukh badhukh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This ocean is filled up with pain and suffering.","ms":"Woe upon woe is filled in the world-ocean."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਦਾ ਵਿਚਲਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਦੁੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46624,"page_no":1091,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's hunger is appeased. ||3||","ms":"Nanak, without the True Name, no one's hunger is satisfied."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੀ ਭੀ (ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਰੇ) ਭੁੱਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਉਤਰਦੀ ।੩।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3840,"next":3842}}
files.shabads/7/3842.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3842,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1091,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46625,"last_verse_id":46630,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46625,"page_no":1091,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46626,"page_no":1091,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"jinee a(n)dhar bhaaliaa gur sabadh suhaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who search their inner beings, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are exalted and adorned.","ms":"Beauteous are they, who reach their heart, through the Guru's word."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":46627,"page_no":1091,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਇਛਨਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"jo ichhan so paidhe har naam dhiaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They obtain what they wish for, meditating on the Lord's Name.","ms":"Meditating on the Lord's Name, they obtain that, what they wish for."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਤੇ ਮਨ-ਇੱਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46628,"page_no":1091,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"jis no kirapaa kare tis gur milai so har gun gaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is blessed by God's Grace, meets with the Guru; he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.","ms":"He, to whom the Lord shows mercy, him meets the Guru and he alone stings to Lord's praise."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46629,"page_no":1091,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharam rai tin kaa mit hai jam mag na paavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Righteous Judge of Dharma is his friend; he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.","ms":"The Righteous judge is his friend and he walks not to the way of death."},"pu":{"ss":"ਧਰਮਰਾਜ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਮਿੱਤਰ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਜਮ ਦੇ ਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਂਦਾ;"}}},{"verse_id":46630,"page_no":1091,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"har naam dhiaaveh dhinas raat har naam samaavai ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He meditates on the Lord's Name, day and night; he is absorbed and immersed in the Lord's Name. ||14||","ms":"God's Name, he contemplates day and night and in the God's Name, he is absorbed."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚ ਜੁੜੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੪।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3841,"next":3843}}

Whatever he has writ, that goes with the mortal."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਉਲੰਘਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ, (ਜੀਆਂ ਦਾ) ਜੋ ਜੋ ਲੇਖ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ (ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ) ਤੋਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46634,"page_no":1091,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਉਣੁ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"kaun mooaa kaun maarasee kaun aavai kaun jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who has died, and who kills? Who comes and who goes?","ms":"Who has died, who has killed him, who is it that comes and goes?"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਸੋ,) ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਮਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਜੰਮਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਹ ਕੋਈ ਮਰਦਾ ਹੈ । "}}},{"verse_id":46635,"page_no":1091,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਕਉਣੁ ਰਹਸੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"kaun rahasee naanakaa kis kee surat samai ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who is enraptured, O Nanak, and whose consciousness merges in the Lord? ||1||","ms":"Who is it that attains bliss and whose soul merges in the Lord, O Nanak?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਹ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਆਨੰਦ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ (ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਵਿਚ) ਟਿਕੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3842,"next":3844}}
files.shabads/7/3844.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3844,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1091,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46636,"last_verse_id":46641,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46636,"page_no":1091,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੧ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa pehilaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"First Mehla:","ms":"1st Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46637,"page_no":1091,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉ ਮੁਆ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥","translit_en":"hau muaa mai maariaa paun vahai dhareeaau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In egotism, he dies; possessiveness kills him, and the breath flows out like a river.","ms":"Through pride, the mortal dies, sense of mine-ness destroys him and the breath flows like the river."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਤਨਾ ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵ ‘ਹਉਮੈ’ ਦਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਦਾ ਦਰਿਆ ਵਹਿੰਦਾ  ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46638,"page_no":1091,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਥਕੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"tirasanaa thakee naanakaa jaa man rataa nai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Desire is exhausted, O Nanak, only when the mind is imbued with the Name.","ms":"The alone man's desire is tired, when his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name, O Nanak."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਰ, ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/7/3845.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3845,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1091,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":46642,"last_verse_id":46647,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46642,"page_no":1091,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":46643,"page_no":1091,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥","translit_en":"eis jug meh naam nidhaan hai naamo naal chalai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure. it is never empty, no matter how much one may eat, consume or spend.","ms":"It is inexhaustible and exhausts not ever, whether one eats, expends or ties it to one's skirt."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ ਨਾਮ-ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਅਮੁੱਕ ਹੈ ਕਦੇ ਮੁੱਕਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਬੇਸ਼ਕ ਖਾਓ ਖਰਚੋ ਤੇ ਪੱਲੇ ਬੰਨੋ੍ਹ;"}}},{"verse_id":46645,"page_no":1091,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਜਮਕਲੈ ॥","translit_en":"har jan neR na aaviee jamaka(n)kar jamakalai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Messenger of Death does not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.","ms":"Death's servant and Death's courier comes not near the Lord's slave."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਫਿਰ, ਇਸ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ ਵਾਲੇ) ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਜਮਕਾਲ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੇ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46646,"page_no":1091,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥","translit_en":"se saeh sache vanajaariaa jin har dhan palai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They alone are the true bankers and traders, who have the wealth of the Lord in their laps.","ms":"They alone are the true banker and traders, who have the Lord's wealth in their lap."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਨਾਮ-ਧਨ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਸੱਚੇ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਹਨ ਉਹੀ ਸੱਚੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":46647,"page_no":1091,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਘਲੈ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"har kirapaa te har paieeaai jaa aap har ghalai ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the Lord's Mercy, one finds the Lord, only when the Lord Himself sends for him. ||15||","ms":"When God Himself sends man to the Guru, then alone he attains unto God, by God's grace."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹ ਨਾਮ-ਧਨ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਆਪ (ਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ) ਭੇਜਦਾ ਹੈ ।੧੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":3844,"next":3846}}
files.shabads/7/3846.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":3846,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":25,"page_no":1091,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":46648,"last_verse_id":46654,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Maaroo","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":46648,"page_no":1091,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":46649,"page_no":1091,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਾਪਾਰੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਖ ਸਿਉ ਧਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"manmukh vaapaarai saar na jaananee bikh vihaajheh bikh sa(n)graheh bikh siau dhareh piaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the excellence of trading in Truth.
